metadata.question: Were active fire counts in Punjab and Haryana during November 2024 lower than during November 2022, as observed with the VIIRS sensor?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: FIRMS VIIRS active fire data (MODIS/006/MOD14A1 or VIIRS) - For VIIRS: "FIRMS" collection or "NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML" - Date: November 2022 vs November 2024 - Location: Punjab and Haryana states in India 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for fire data - Fire data is point-based (each detection is a fire) - Count total fires in each region for each time period 3. Logic: - Valid comparison: Count fires in both periods - C1: If no images/fire data for either period - C2: Not applicable for fire points (no pixel masking) - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN - A: If 2024 count < 2022 count (lower fires in 2024) - B: If 2024 count >= 2022 count (not lower in 2024) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Punjab and Haryana regions (approximate boundaries) const punjab = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[73.5, 29.5], [76.8, 29.5], [76.8, 32.5], [73.5, 32.5], [73.5, 29.5]] ]); const haryana = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[74.5, 27.5], [77.5, 27.5], [77.5, 30.8], [74.5, 30.8], [74.5, 27.5]] ]); const region = punjab.union(haryana); // Define time periods const start2022 = '2022-11-01'; const end2022 = '2022-11-30'; const start2024 = '2024-11-01'; const end2024 = '2024-11-30'; // Load VIIRS active fire data const viirs2022 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML') .filterDate(start2022, end2022) .filterBounds(region); const viirs2024 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML') .filterDate(start2024, end2024) .filterBounds(region); // Check collection sizes const size2022 = viirs2022.size().getInfo(); const size2024 = viirs2024.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Nov 2022 Images: ${size2022}`); console.log(`Nov 2024 Images: ${size2024}`); if (size2022 === 0 || size2024 === 0) { console.log('Missing data for one or both periods.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Count fires by summing the fire mask band const fires2022 = viirs2022.select('FireMask').mosaic(); const fires2024 = viirs2024.select('FireMask').mosaic(); const count2022Result = fires2022.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count2024Result = fires2024.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const fireCount2022 = count2022Result.get('FireMask').getInfo(); const fireCount2024 = count2024Result.get('FireMask').getInfo(); console.log(`Fire pixels Nov 2022: ${fireCount2022}`); console.log(`Fire pixels Nov 2024: ${fireCount2024}`); // Validation if (fireCount2022 === null || fireCount2024 === null || isNaN(fireCount2022) || isNaN(fireCount2024)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare fire counts if (fireCount2024 < fireCount2022) { console.log('2024 fires < 2022 fires: LOWER'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('2024 fires >= 2022 fires: NOT LOWER'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
